description: Implementation of QuicSimpleServerSession class handling QUIC server session logic, stream creation, and WebTransport support within the quic namespace.

classes.name: QuicSimpleServerSession
classes.description: A class managing a QUIC server session, handling stream creation, WebTransport negotiation, and connection lifecycle.

methods.name: QuicSimpleServerSession
methods.description: Constructor initializing the server session with configuration, connection, backend, and other parameters.

methods.name: ~QuicSimpleServerSession
methods.description: Destructor cleaning up the session, including connection deletion.

methods.name: CreateQuicCryptoServerStream
methods.description: Creates a new QUIC crypto server stream.

methods.name: OnStreamFrame
methods.description: Handles incoming stream frames, closing connection if data is sent on server push streams without WebTransport.

methods.name: CreateIncomingStream
methods.description: Creates an incoming stream given a stream ID or pending stream.

methods.name: CreateOutgoingBidirectionalStream
methods.description: Creates an outgoing bidirectional stream if WebTransport is supported.
